context.passage:
Instructions for San Aldo University Press Authors
San Aldo University Press is pleased to be publishing your forthcoming
book. Carefully follow these instructions for preparing and submitting
your manuscript. Failure to do so may result in book production delays
or increased production fees.
* The text file of your manuscript should include all content from the title page to the
list of references.
¢ If applicable, save and supply digital artwork, tables, and charts as individual files.
¢ If applicable, obtain signed permissions for digital artwork; permission forms can be
obtained from www.saupress.sau.edu/author.
* Review the author checklist, downloadable from www.saupress.sau.edu/author.
Please e-mail all these documents directly to your San Aldo University Press editor.
San Aldo University Press
130 Oceanside Way
San Aldo, California 95523
saupress.sau.edu
January 12
Kwon Tae-Hwan
16 Yeonsan 4-dong
Yeonje-gu, Busan
South Korea
Dear Dr. Kwon,
Your coauthor just e-mailed the remainder of your permission forms to me, and I now
have all materials needed to begin the production phase for The Economics of Simple
Living. A production schedule is enclosed; we are still on track for a July release.
Please review and make note of important dates that require action from you and
your coauthor. In the meantime, should you have any editorial questions, please
contact me, as usual.
I look forward to your visit at the end of August, when we will have the kickoff of
your promotional tour at San Aldo University’s bookstore.
Best regards,
Zahera Sadik
Zahera Sadik
Editor, Economics & Political Science
650-555-0179 ext. 11
zahera @ saupress.sau.edu
~\
(From; Kwon Tae-Hwan
Received: February 20, 1:14 pM.
To: Talia Burstein
Talia, | shared our edits to the book
jacket with Zahera and Eugene.
They will e-mail the updated text
for the book cover later today. We
will need to provide immediate
feedback, so keep checking your
e-mail throughout the evening.
+b LSAL
Thanks.
_\f
Lo_
context.passage_translation:
致 San Aldo University Press 作者
San Aldo University Press 很高兴能出版您即将出版的书籍。
请仔细遵循这些说明来准备和提交您的稿件。未能这样做可能会导致书籍制作延误或增加的制作费用。
* 您的文稿文本文件应包含从扉页到参考文献列表的所有内容。
¢ 如果适用，请将数字艺术作品、表格和图表作为单独的文件保存和提供。
¢ 如果适用，请为数字艺术作品获取签署的许可；许可表格可从 www.saupress.sau.edu/author 获取。
* 请审阅作者核对清单，可从 www.saupress.sau.edu/author 下载。
请将所有这些文件直接发送给您的 San Aldo University Press 编辑。
San Aldo University Press
130 Oceanside Way
San Aldo, California 95523
saupress.sau.edu
1月12日
Kwon Tae-Hwan
16 Yeonsan 4-dong
Yeonje-gu, Busan
韩国
尊敬的 Kwon 博士：
您的合著者刚刚将您剩余的许可表格通过电子邮件发送给了我，我现在拥有了开始《简单生活经济学》制作阶段所需的所有材料。随信附上了一份制作时间表；我们仍有望在七月发布。
请审阅并注意需要您和您的合著者采取行动的重要日期。同时，如果您有任何编辑问题，请像往常一样与我联系。
我期待您八月底的访问，届时我们将在 San Aldo 大学书店启动您的宣传巡回。
此致，
Zahera Sadik
Zahera Sadik
经济学与政治科学编辑
650-555-0179 分机 11
zahera @ saupress.sau.edu
~\\n(来自；Kwon Tae-Hwan
收到：2月20日，下午 1:14。
收件人：Talia Burstein
Talia，| 我已将我们对书籍封面的修改稿与 Zahera 和 Eugene 分享了。
他们今天晚些时候会发送更新后的书籍封面文本。我们需要立即提供反馈，所以请在整个晚上留意您的电子邮件。
+b LSAL
谢谢。
_\f
Lo_
